answer: Layered bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond in three layers at a lagoon registry — a base seal, a nebula archive receipt, and an ember proof. Any layer failing burns the whole bond, so all three must be faked. First filing costs 35, the kth 35+6(k-1); 1,000 forged identities cost 3,032,000, with 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented ember proofs share one serial; auditors flag the ring. An honest agent pays 35 once, keeps the bond.
